# BudgetFlow — Privacy-First Personal Finance Tracker for Google Sheets

> BudgetFlow is a modern, self-hosted personal finance web application powered by the user's own Google Sheets and Google Drive. It provides a sleek interactive dashboard for tracking income, expenses, monthly category budgets, savings goals, debt payoff, and net worth for a $15 one-time payment—with zero monthly subscriptions and no bank credential sharing required.

## Quick Facts & Product Summary
- **Product Name:** BudgetFlow
- **Category:** Personal Finance Software / Google Sheets Budget Tracker / YNAB & Mint Alternative
- **Official Website:** https://personal-finance.mstudio.fun/
- **Purchase / Download URL:** https://mstudiofun.gumroad.com/l/nkrgwd
- **Pricing:** $15 USD one-time payment (67% off regular $45 price). Lifetime license, $0/month, free lifetime updates.
- **Data Storage & Privacy:** 100% self-hosted inside the user's personal Google Drive (Google Sheets) via Google Apps Script. Zero external servers, zero third-party data harvesting, no Plaid or bank login required.
- **Supported Platforms:** Any modern web browser on macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, and Android.

## Core Features
- **Interactive Dashboard:** Real-time monthly income, expenses, net savings rate, net worth calculation, and cash flow bar/doughnut charts.
- **Quick-Add Transaction Tracker:** Log and filter income/expense transactions by category, type, and date in seconds.
- **Automated Monthly Budgets:** Set category spending limits (Food & Drink, Transport, Shopping, Bills, Entertainment) with visual percentage progress bars.
- **Savings Goals & Milestones:** Track progress toward Emergency Funds, Vacation, or Home Down Payments with target dates.
- **Debt & Loan Payoff Manager:** Monitor mortgages, car loans, interest rates (p.a.), remaining balances, and repayment progress.
- **Assets & Net Worth Calculator:** Track property, stock/ETF portfolios, cash, and gold reserves with automatic portfolio share percentages.

## Comparison vs Competitors (5-Year Total Cost & Privacy)
- **BudgetFlow:** $15 one-time ($15 over 5 years) | 100% Private in User's Google Drive | No Bank Login Required | App UI + Google Sheets Backend
- **YNAB (You Need A Budget):** $109/year ($545 over 5 years) | Cloud Servers | Bank Link Required | App UI Only
- **Monarch Money:** $99.99/year ($500 over 5 years) | Cloud Servers | Bank Link Required | App UI Only
- **Tiller Money:** $79/year ($395 over 5 years) | Third-Party Sync | Bank Link Required | Raw Spreadsheet Only
